key_decisions: Use a single Maven Spring Boot backend under backend/ with controller, service, repository, domain, dto, exception, and validation layers.
Use H2 for local development and tests to avoid external service dependencies in the empty project.
Use Vite React TypeScript under frontend/ for the PC admin console.
Define global backend exception and validation utilities once because no preset utility code exists; controllers and services must reuse them.
Model inventory as immutable stock_movement ledger rows and calculate current stock from quantity deltas.
Create purchase inbound and sales outbound documents with item rows and matching stock movements inside service transactions.
Expose REST endpoints for supplier, category, product, purchase, sales, inventory, and slow-moving report workflows.
Require backend validation as source of truth and frontend validation as user-experience support.
risks: Document editing can corrupt inventory if item updates and stock movement reconciliation are not handled in one transaction.
Concurrent sales may oversell stock unless service-level stock checks are transactional and tested.
Slow-moving report semantics may need product-owner confirmation for threshold defaults and handling products with no sales history.
The run states package manager and test commands as unknown until backend/frontend scaffolding is created.
No authentication requirement is present; adding it later will affect API and frontend routing.
